title: Accept an mtime-one gzip container by its payload digest
body:
## Summary
- Level-9 gzip of one fixed payload differs in header bytes 4 through 7 when the mtime is 0 or 1. The digest of the mtime-zero container rejects the mtime-one container.
- Both containers decompress to the same payload, sha256 `0ca09c6bea5b4320135b555d02c56d208cbb2d0cd699708d1dc3c57a0a376b60`. The payload digest accepts the alternate container.
- Partial result. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change. The balanced-split verifier and the shipped archive are unchanged.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/gzip-mtime-payload/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/gzip-mtime-payload/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gzip-mtime-payload`
- [ ] Maintainer replay on canonical main
